requirements.summary: Audit and fix App.tsx to remove route definitions that simultaneously set both an id and a path option
acceptanceCriteria: No route object in App.tsx has both an `id` and a `path` property simultaneously
The router initializes without throwing 'Route cannot have both an id and a path option'
All existing page routes remain navigable

file_operations.description: Remove any route definitions that set both `id` and `path` simultaneously. If a route has both properties, remove the `id` property and keep only the `path`. Verify all route paths are correctly defined and navigation links remain functional

requirements.summary: Fix image source rendering utility and audit all components that render product or template images
acceptanceCriteria: Product and template images stored as plain HTTP URLs render correctly without a malformed `data:image/jpeg;base64,https://...` prefix
Images stored as genuine base64 data URIs continue to display correctly
No broken image icons appear in product cards, product detail, cart, or admin pages

file_operations.description: Fix the image source normalization logic to correctly detect when an image source is a plain HTTP/HTTPS URL and return it as-is without prepending a base64 data URI prefix. Ensure genuine base64 data URIs (starting with 'data:image/') are preserved correctly. The function should detect: (1) data URIs starting with 'data:image/' and return them unchanged, (2) HTTP/HTTPS URLs starting with 'http://' or 'https://' and return them unchanged, (3) relative paths and return them unchanged, (4) raw base64 strings (no prefix) and prepend 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' only for those

requirements.summary: Fix admin session credential validation in useAdminSession.ts
acceptanceCriteria: Logging in with username `genmitra` and password `12345678` sets the admin session successfully
Logging in with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` sets the admin session successfully
Invalid credentials are still rejected
No stale session state causes a valid login to silently fail

file_operations.description: Fix the login function credential validation to correctly accept both hardcoded admin accounts: (1) username 'genmitra' with password '12345678' and (2) username 'admin' with password 'Admin@1234'. Use strict equality checks for both username and password. On successful validation, set sessionStorage with the admin session data including role 'admin'. Clear any stale cached state before setting new session data. Ensure invalid credentials are rejected with appropriate error messages

requirements.summary: Audit and fix LoginPage.tsx to ensure proper admin and user login flows
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to `/admin` while unauthenticated shows only the username/password form with no Internet Identity elements
Submitting valid admin credentials redirects to `/admin`
Internet Identity login works correctly for non-admin users and redirects to the homepage
No silent form submission failures occur

file_operations.description: Fix the login page to correctly detect admin login mode (when arriving from an admin route via referrer or URL state). In admin mode: (a) render only the username/password credential form and hide all Internet Identity UI elements, (b) call the login function from useAdminSession on form submission without early returns or silent swallows, (c) redirect to '/admin' or the originally requested admin URL on successful validation. In regular user mode: render the Internet Identity login UI, call login from useInternetIdentity, and redirect to the homepage after successful authentication. Ensure form submission errors are displayed to the user

requirements.summary: Audit and fix AdminGuard.tsx to ensure it only checks local credential-based admin session
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/admin` while unauthenticated redirects to the login page without triggering Internet Identity
A valid admin session allows the admin route to render
AdminGuard imports no Internet Identity hooks and calls no `login()` function from them

file_operations.description: Remove any imports of useInternetIdentity or any Internet Identity-related hooks. Remove any calls to Internet Identity login functions. The guard must only use useAdminSession to check if an admin session exists. If no valid admin session is found, redirect to the login page (pass admin mode context if needed). If a valid session exists, render the protected route content. Show a loading spinner while the session check is in progress

requirements.summary: Verify and fix all mutation hooks in useQueries.ts to use authenticated actor
acceptanceCriteria: All six mutation hooks use the authenticated actor when called from admin pages
No mutation sends an anonymous caller principal to the backend
Admin product and template CRUD operations succeed without authorization errors

file_operations.description: Audit the six admin mutation hooks (createTemplate, updateTemplate, deleteTemplate, createProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct) and ensure each one derives the actor instance from the current authenticated identity context on each mutation call, not from a captured anonymous actor at definition time. Use the useActor hook within each mutation's mutationFn to get the authenticated actor. Verify the authenticated actor is used for all backend write operations so the caller principal is correctly passed to the backend authorization checks

requirements.summary: Fix useGetProduct query hook and ProductDetailPage to correctly extract and pass product ID
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a product card navigates to the ProductDetailPage and the product data loads without a 'Product not found' error
The product ID extracted from the route matches the key format used in the stable products map
Demo products are present after every deploy

file_operations.description: Fix the useGetProduct hook to correctly extract the product ID parameter and ensure the type passed to the backend getProduct call matches the expected backend type (check if backend expects Nat or Text). If the route param is a string and backend expects Text, pass it directly. If backend expects Nat, parse the string to a number. Handle any type mismatches between the route param format and the backend function signature

Verify the product ID is correctly extracted from route parameters using the router's param extraction API. Pass the extracted ID to the useGetProduct hook. Ensure the ID format matches what the backend expects. Handle loading and error states appropriately, and fall back to demo product data only if the backend query explicitly returns null (not on network errors)

requirements.summary: Audit index.html CSP meta tag and message event listeners to whitelist Caffeine preview origin
acceptanceCriteria: The `frame-ancestors` directive is absent from the CSP `<meta>` tag
`https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` is included in all origin whitelists and relevant CSP directives
No 'disallowed origin' errors appear when the app is loaded inside the Caffeine preview iframe
All other CSP directives remain unchanged

file_operations.description: Remove the frame-ancestors directive from the Content-Security-Policy meta tag (it is ineffective in a meta tag and should only be set via HTTP headers). Add 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' to the frame-src and script-src directives if not already present. Preserve all other CSP directives exactly as-is. Do not modify any other meta tags or HTML structure
Audit any window.addEventListener('message', handler) callbacks and ensure 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' is included in the origin whitelist for postMessage validation

requirements.summary: Audit all DialogContent usages and add DialogDescription to each
acceptanceCriteria: No Radix UI accessibility warning about missing `DialogDescription` appears in the browser console
Every `DialogContent` in the codebase has a `<DialogDescription>` child or `aria-describedby={undefined}`
The visual layout of all dialogs is unchanged

file_operations.description: Audit all DialogContent components and add a DialogDescription child to each. Where a visible description is not appropriate, use a visually hidden DialogDescription with a 'sr-only' class. Alternatively, pass aria-describedby={undefined} to DialogContent if no description is semantically needed. Ensure the visual layout remains unchanged
